role: Declares HealthKitServiceProtocol, the @MainActor abstraction of the HealthKit queries MorningProcessingService, SessionAcceptanceService, ReanalysisService, HRVAnalysisPipeline and SleepBoundaryResolver make (so tests can inject MockHealthKitService); adds default-argument conveniences and the HealthKitManager conformance bridge.
types: HealthKitServiceProtocol: protocol — the HealthKit queries dispatched through it (sleep, nap minutes, RR and HR sleep estimates, daytime resting HR, training load, recovery vitals, session export)
HealthKitServiceProtocol: extension — default-argument conveniences and nap default 0
toplevel: HealthKitManager declares conformance (bottom of file). Protocol also requires the nonisolated property isHealthKitAvailable. Authorization, sleep observers, trends, exports and dashboard queries are not requirements; callers use HealthKitManager directly.

units.does: Protocol requirement fetchSleepData(for:recordingEnd:rrPoints:autoSleepExtension:rrStart:): resolves sleep for a recording window, optionally validated by RR, with an auto-sleep extension envelope, and with rrStart (when the strap recording the beats started, for a search range wider than the recording; nil = recordingStart).
units.entry: Protocol requirement; witnesses: HealthKitManager (concrete, HealthKitManager+SleepQueryForwarding.swift), MockHealthKitService. Dispatched through the protocol by the extension conveniences in this file, used by SessionAcceptanceService, MorningProcessingService, ReanalysisService and SleepBoundaryResolver.
